messages.content:
Hi there, thank you for bringing your exciting idea for PetCare TeleVet to our team. I'm thrilled to be working with you to turn your concept into a reality. It sounds like you're envisioning a 24/7 tele-health mobile consultation platform that connects pet owners with licensed veterinarians for video consultations - I love the vision of making quality veterinary care more accessible to pet owners.

As your Business Analyst for this project, my role is to ask some questions to help us clarify and refine your idea into a clear, testable plan that the rest of the team can build from. Before we dive in, I want to make sure I have your permission to get started. Mind if I ask a few questions to get started?
